correspondence_basis: Frozen original SDK technical proposals and independent SDK identity-eligibility judgments, not human verified.
gt_resize: Nearest-neighbor instance-ID map, 640x360; RGB is never used to infer GT masks.
student_camera: Unchanged original active camera, evaluated opaque geometry proxies.
render_approximation: Opaque evaluated geometry proxies preserve original object transforms and active camera.
All selected geometry uses white emission; other geometry uses black emission.
Glass, alpha blending, transmission, hair, volumes and shader displacement are not appearance-faithful masks.
Opaque non-target geometry can hide a target that was visible through glass in the RGB.
4 primary-path samples and a later 0.5 threshold approximate antialiasing boundaries.
Viewport evaluated geometry is used after matching modifier visibility and subdivision render levels.
Original render borders and compositor effects are disabled; their presence is recorded.
No GT image, mask, scene, camera or transform is available to this rendering process.

normalized_center_convention: Mean visible pixel centers ((x+0.5)/width, (y+0.5)/height), x rightward and y downward; L2 in these normalized coordinates.
alignment: 2D original image frames only; no 3D coordinate, scale, position or angle alignment or error.
unmatched_objects: Not imputed. Missing, ambiguous, low-confidence or duplicate mappings remain unknown.
empty_mask: Visible IoU/recall can be zero, but absent center/precision remain undefined; no zero-error imputation.
